visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a white t-shirt stands in a bright retail environment, holding a green skincare jar and pointing at it with a smile; behind him, a large digital screen shows a woman's face and English text. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up display shelf featuring various silver and green skincare bottles arranged neatly on white platforms with green circular accents. (3) The man stands before the brand counter, gesturing towards the product display while speaking animatedly; the background shows high-end mall walkways. (4) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a transparent bottle with green liquid inside, labeled 'Targeted 4D Hydration Serum'. (5) The man introduces a woman with short hair and a black outfit, who waves towards the camera in a friendly manner. (6) The man and woman stand together, interacting and gesturing towards the green serum bottle held between them; both exhibit smiling, high-energy expressions. (7) A macro close-up depicts the man's hand pressing the pump of the green bottle, dispensing a clear gel onto his other hand, followed by a finger spreading the shimmering texture. (8) The camera returns to the duo laughing; the man points at his face while the woman reacts with a hand near her mouth. (9) A close-up shot shows a silver jar of 'Rescue Balm' being held and opened to reveal a white cream. (10) The cream is applied and rubbed into the skin of a hand, demonstrating its smooth, spreadable texture. (11) The woman explains the product while the man listens intently, holding the jar; they are positioned in front of a brand poster. (12) A close-up shows a silver bottle of 'Bio-3' eye serum, followed by a demonstration of its golden-hued liquid being applied to a hand. (13) The man and woman engage in a humorous exchange, with the man laughing heartily and leaning back while the woman continues to talk. (14) The video concludes with the man holding three different RéVive products toward the camera, smiling broadly and nodding.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interaction with Consultant -> Product A Demo -> Product B Demo -> Product C Demo -> Summary Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for RéVive skincare products. It utilizes a high-energy vlog format where a male influencer visits a department store counter to interview a brand expert. By demonstrating multiple products—serums and eye masks—through texture close-ups and humorous personal anecdotes about their long-term friendship, the video aims to build brand trust and encourage viewers to purchase the items for skin hydration and anti-aging benefits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of RéVive products, mention of the SOGO location, and explicit verbal recommendation of the brand.
